example_summary: Computation of tax liability for Mr. Mahesh under Section 115BAC for A.Y. 2026-27 with total income of ₹ 11,00,000 resulting in a tax liability of Nil after Section 87A rebate.
source_provision:
### Statutory Framework: Section 115BAC & Section 87A

| Provision | Target Assessee | Operative Condition / Threshold | Tax Treatment / Benefit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Section 115BAC** | Individual, HUF, AOP, BOI, AJP | Default Tax Regime for computation of total income | Concessional progressive slab rates |
| **Section 87A** | Resident Individual | Total Income within prescribed statutory threshold | Rebate equal to 100% of Tax Payable (up to maximum limit) |
| **Section 87A Proviso** | Resident Individual | Total Income slightly exceeds threshold | Marginal relief capped at Income exceeding threshold |

#### Key Statutory Rules & Conditions

* **Applicability of Default Regime**: Section 115BAC applies automatically unless the assessee exercises an option to shift to the normal regime under Section 115BAC(6).
* **Eligibility for Rebate u/s 87A**: Available **only to Resident Individuals**; non-residents and non-individual assessees cannot claim this rebate.
* **Quantum of Rebate**: Lower of actual Tax Payable or the statutory maximum limit (e.g., ₹ 60,000 / ₹ 25,000 depending on statutory ceiling).

> [!IMPORTANT] Statutory Distinction
> Section 87A rebate applies on net tax before Health and Education Cess. Non-resident individuals are strictly ineligible for Section 87A rebate regardless of their income level.

director.justification: The tax computation involves applying progressive slab rates under Section 115BAC to Mr. Mahesh's income of ₹ 11,00,000 followed by applying the Section 87A rebate.
director.visual_metaphor: A step-ladder representing the 115BAC tax slabs leading up to total tax liability, which is then wiped clean by a Section 87A rebate shield.

beat_plan.beat_goal: Introduce Mr. Mahesh, a resident individual with ₹ 11,00,000 total income for Assessment Year 2026-27 evaluated under Section 115BAC.
Ascend the Section 115BAC tax slabs to calculate tax on each slice of income.
Tally the slab amounts of ₹ 20,000 and ₹ 30,000 to arrive at total tax payable of ₹ 50,000 before rebate.
Verify statutory conditions for claiming tax rebate under Section 87A.
Deduct Section 87A rebate equal to tax payable of ₹ 50,000 to compute final net tax liability of Nil.

beats.voice_sync_text: slab amounts ആയ ₹ 20,000 ഉം ₹ 30,000 ഉം കൂടി tally ചെയ്ത് total tax payable എത്രയെന്ന് നോക്കാം. Rebate-ന് മുൻപുള്ള total tax payable ഇവിടെ ₹ 50,000 ആയി ലഭിക്കുന്നു.

beats.voice_sync_text: അടുത്തതായി Section 87A tax rebate क्लेम ചെയ്യാനുള്ള statutory conditions verify ചെയ്യാം. ഇദ്ദേഹം ഒരു Resident Individual ആണ്, കൂടാതെ Tax Payable ഉം ഉണ്ട്. ആയതിനാൽ rebate കിട്ടാൻ അർഹതയുണ്ട്.
